evidence.quote: You call the 10 to match the big blind, which sees the flop at 40 in the pot.
New hand. Blinds are back up: you post 10, I post 20, bankroll 920.

criteria.why: Every reply is short, plain table talk. It never shows JSON, component ids, or tool talk.

evidence.quote: You bet 50 and I call, so the pot is 140.
You fold, so the dealer takes the 30 in the pot.
You raise to 100 and I call, so the pot is 200.

criteria.why: Each bet, check, fold, raise and Deal again click is acted on in the same turn, and the hand moves forward.

evidence.quote: The dealer shows 7♣ 2♦, which makes a pair of twos with the 2♠ on the board.

criteria.why: The Croupier deals the streets, plays the dealer's checks and calls, reveals the hand and settles the pot. It never makes a choice for the player.

evidence.quote: The dealer wins the 140 pot, and you lose the 70 you put in.
You lose your 10 small blind, and your bankroll goes to 920.
I'm dealing you a fresh round on a new table, bankroll at 930.

criteria.why: Totals and results match the surface text each turn. One small slip: the first hand took the 10 blind out of the bankroll at the deal (990), but the later hands did not (930, 920) until the fold.
